title: Duplicate IOB, COB and in treatments
symptom: At 07:28 this morning, I gave 1u and announced 10g using the calculator. It definitely only gave 1u, but the treatments show 1u and 10g have been given twice and 2u and 20g were added to the IOB and COB respectively, although only 1u and 10g are showing on the graph.
